title: AssertionError when using '=' instead of ':' to define a protocol attribute with specialized type

labels.name: topic-type-alias
labels.description: TypeAlias and other type alias issues

body:
**Bug Report**

After (accidentally) using `=` instead of `:` in a protocol definition, mypy may crash when trying to type-check an object follows the protocol

**To Reproduce**

Write this in a .py file:

```py
from typing import List, Protocol, Type

class MyProto(Protocol):
    foo = List[str]

class MyClass:
    foo = ["bar"]

my_cls: Type[MyProto] = MyClass
```

and run mypy on it

**Expected Behavior**

Should error with `All protocol members must have explicitly declared types` on line 4, and/or `Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "Type[MyClass]", variable has type "Type[MyProto]")` on line 9

**Actual Behavior**

```
$ mypy crash_mypy.py --show-traceback
crash_mypy.py:9: error: INTERNAL ERROR -- Please try using mypy master on Github:
https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/common_issues.html#using-a-development-mypy-build
Please report a bug at https://github.com/python/mypy/issues
version: 0.942
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "mypy/checker.py", line 424, in accept
  File "mypy/nodes.py", line 1155, in accept
  File "mypy/checker.py", line 2204, in visit_assignment_stmt
  File "mypy/checker.py", line 2370, in check_assignment
  File "mypy/checker.py", line 3294, in check_simple_assignment
  File "mypy/checker.py", line 5203, in check_subtype
  File "mypy/subtypes.py", line 94, in is_subtype
  File "mypy/subtypes.py", line 151, in _is_subtype
  File "mypy/types.py", line 1328, in accept
  File "mypy/subtypes.py", line 357, in visit_callable_type
  File "mypy/subtypes.py", line 205, in _is_subtype
  File "mypy/subtypes.py", line 94, in is_subtype
  File "mypy/subtypes.py", line 151, in _is_subtype
  File "mypy/types.py", line 1065, in accept
  File "mypy/subtypes.py", line 286, in visit_instance
  File "mypy/subtypes.py", line 588, in is_protocol_implementation
AssertionError: 
crash_mypy.py:9: : note: use --pdb to drop into pdb
```

  Did something go wrong?

-->

**Your Environment**

- Mypy version used: 0.942
- Mypy command-line flags: either none or `--show-traceback`
- Mypy configuration options from `mypy.ini` (and other config files): none
- Python version used: 3.9
- Operating system and version: Debian 11
